tell: An ALK and RET kinase inhibitor with a large food effect: a high-fat meal raises combined exposure 3.1-fold.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is 37%, and a high-fat meal raises combined exposure 3.1-fold. It is more than 99% bound to plasma protein, and most of a dose leaves unchanged in the feces.
A hydrochloride salt whose free base weighs 482.62, with a pKa of 7.05.
Approved under an NDA as 150 mg hard capsules, taken as 600 mg twice daily.
No boxed warning and no contraindications. Hepatotoxicity (41%) and constipation (39%) are the most common adverse reactions.
Adjuvant treatment after tumor resection of biomarker-selected non-small cell lung cancer, and treatment of metastatic biomarker-selected lung cancer.
Inhibits the ALK and RET kinases, blocking ALK phosphorylation and downstream STAT3 and AKT signaling.
The generic name begins with A and has nine letters.
